calendarDate.description: Source of the test date, consumed by sync_lactate_threshold. Bug #56 (fixed): code previously read nonexistent testDate/date/dateTime keys.

speed.description: Value is 1/10th of true m/s (not plain m/s). Consumed as lt_pace_s_per_km via 100.0 / speed. Bug #56 first fix wrongly assumed plain m/s (1000.0 / speed), which was still 10x off; verified 2026-07-30 against connect.garmin.com's Lactate Threshold report's chart tooltips at 4 separate dates (exact digit values, see CLAUDE.md's unit table) — raw speed only matches the displayed pace via 100.0 / speed in every case, e.g. 0.33888794 -> 4:55/km (295 s/km).

heartRate.description: Consumed as lt_hr_bpm. Bug #56 (fixed): code previously read a nonexistent top-level heartRateThreshold instead.

power.description: Functional threshold power data — separate from the HR/pace threshold, not currently modeled by any sync.py field.

title: Lactate threshold (get_lactate_threshold)
description:
Returned by garminconnect's get_lactate_threshold() — no date argument, most-recent test only. Bug #56 (fixed): sync_lactate_threshold previously read heartRateThreshold/paceThreshold/testDate, none of which exist in the real response. Real shape is nested under speed_and_heart_rate and power.

Verified against: most-recent test on this account, dated 2026-07-06 (speed_and_heart_rate) / 2026-07-19 (power) — the two sub-objects have different calendarDates, meaning unconfirmed (possibly last-updated timestamps for that specific metric, not the same test). Additional fields beyond what's listed here may exist and are tolerated (additionalProperties: true) — Garmin adding new fields is not a breaking change; a listed field disappearing or changing type is.
